text:
maria: Heads up — small hotfix for autoscaler routing bug in dedicated pools causing intermittent 429s in prod-eu. Seeing customer errors and spikes in retry traffic. Need expedited deploy in ~30m.
chen: Oncall, can you triage? I pulled logs, looks like router-proxy v2.1.4 drops state during rebind.
sam: Reproduced on staging, fix is one-line change to route merge order. Unit + e2e ✅. Build artifact: sha=abcd1234.
maria: Opening expedited request. PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4321 — small inverse-order patch. No DB migrations.
releasebot: deploy request created by maria for prod-eu. CI: green. Requesting expedited approval. Canary plan: 5% for 10m, health checks: 200 OK, 5xx rate, tail latency.
chen: I can take oncall watch. Quick review: any config changes?
sam: No config changes, just code path reorder. I can watch metrics and rollback if errors spike.
jamal: ops: +1 from me if sam watches canary and oncall is active. This meets emergency criteria (customer impact, low blast radius).
chen: +1 from oncall. Setting pager to sam and jamal.
maria: Approvals: jamal +1, sam +1, chen +1. Proceed when deploybot ready. :thumbsup:
deploybot: starting rollout to prod-eu canary (5%). Targets: shard-3 nodes. Artifact sha=abcd1234.
sam: Canary live — initial health ok, latency stable, 429 rate dropped ~80% on canary.
oncall-bot: Alerts monitor configured: telemetry:prod-eu.router.5xx, telemetry:prod-eu.router.latency. Notify: sam, chen.
maria: If canary holds for 10m, promote to 50%.
deploybot: promoting to 50% after passing canary checks (10m).
sam: 50% looks good. No regression in downstream queues.
maria: Roll to 100% now.
deploybot: rollout to 100% in progress...
deploybot: rollout complete for prod-eu. No post-deploy alerts.
chen: Good catch, nice turnaround team. I'll close the incident and file a short blameless postmortem.
maria: Postmortem action: add a unit test for route-state order + note in release notes.
chen: For quick rollback if needed:```
./deploy rollback --target=prod-eu --to-sha=9f8e7d6c
```
sam: Thanks everyone. Logging follow-up infra ticket for autoscaler e2e.
maria: Closing thread.
